target: Private relationship-memory landing and internal beta entry

contract.purpose: Explain Kith as a private iPhone memory app for people, chosen closeness, standing context, and dated moments.
contract.purposeSource: site-health/docs/project-dossiers/kith.yaml plus PRODUCT.md, DESIGN.md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, and current Swift source
contract.canonicalPurpose: Kith helps a person remember the people they genuinely want to stay close to and act with more thoughtfulness.
contract.audience: An iPhone user who values a small set of relationships and dislikes treating them like a sales CRM.
contract.job: Show the explicit-closeness constellation, one-person memory loop, local working copy, optional private sync, and honest beta availability.
contract.thesis: A name in a phone is not the context of a relationship; small remembered details make care specific.
contract.system: Warm linen-and-clay landing with a real constellation screen, lantern geometry, three-part memory loop, fit boundaries, privacy, beta status, project strip, and Ask AI footer.
contract.signature: The real Kith constellation sits inside a gridded field, with bubble size visibly tied to the closeness the user chose.
contract.risk: Avoid CRM language, inferred closeness, contact import, reminders, public profiles, web or iPad clients, public download, and permanent pricing claims.

answers.product: A private iPhone app that keeps a small constellation of people and a dated memory log for each one.
answers.audience: Someone who wants to remember the people they care about without using a CRM, contact importer, or social network.
answers.value: It keeps how you met, standing notes, birthdays, and small dated moments close enough to help you show up thoughtfully.
answers.mechanism: The user sets closeness from 1 to 5, opens a person from the constellation or list, and adds a short dated entry to the local document.
answers.proof: The page uses real constellation, person, and onboarding screens and names the exact storage and sync roles.
answers.nextAction: Inspect the real screens or read the honest internal TestFlight status.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner delegated fleet landing repairs and asked the agent to continue without project-by-project feedback pauses.
